snippet: Netflix is buying Ben Affleck-founded AI film-tech startup InterPositive, signaling how streamers plan to automate parts of production and reshape Hollywood workflows. #Netflix #AI #Hollywood
Hollywood’s AI shift continues: Netflix’s move on InterPositive is less about star power and more about owning the tools that compress timelines, budgets and creative risk.

SoftBank is weighing a loan of up to $40B to back OpenAI, underlining how capital-intensive the generative AI race has become—and how much leverage big financiers can gain over core AI infrastructure.
A potential $40B SoftBank loan to support an OpenAI deal would blur lines between tech and structured finance, concentrating even more power in a few AI platforms and their backers.
